metadata.author: By Pancho Harrison / Edited by Mike Shenk

entries.clue: Sidney Lumet film set at the Union Broadcasting Systems
Comment at the end of an exhausting day
1970 Grammy winner for writing "A Boy Named Sue" (25)
Best Director nominee for "A Room With a View" (14)

1984 inductee to the Songwriters Hall of Fame (60)

Comic member of the Grand Ole Opry cast for over 50 years (30)
Frodo's portrayer in "The Lord of the Rings" (5)
